story description: As a student, I want my questions and requests to be automatically sent to the right school department, so that I get help quickly without having to figure out who to ask.
Pre-Requirements: Student must be logged into the student portal; support departments/categories must be set up in the system

story description: As a student, I want to receive a notification confirming which department received my request, so that I know my request is being handled and who to expect a response from.
Pre-Requirements: AI routing engine (Story 1) is implemented; notification service (email/in-app) is configured

story description: As a student, I want my request to be reviewed by a staff member when the AI is unsure how to classify it, so that my request still gets routed correctly instead of being lost or mishandled.
Pre-Requirements: AI routing engine (Story 1) is implemented; confidence threshold is configured; staff review queue exists

story description: As a support staff member, I want a dashboard that shows all escalated and unassigned student requests, so that I can quickly review and route them to the correct department.
Pre-Requirements: Staff member must have a 'support' role account; escalation flow (Story 3) is implemented

story description: As a student, I want to check the status of a request I submitted (Received, In Progress, or Resolved), so that I know what is happening with it without contacting the department directly.
Pre-Requirements: AI routing engine (Story 1) is implemented; request status field is defined in the data model

story description: As a student submitting an urgent issue (e.g., a health or safety emergency), I want the system to automatically detect the urgency and immediately alert the right department, so that critical issues are handled without delay.
Pre-Requirements: AI classification model (Story 1) is implemented; a real-time alert channel (SMS/email/push) is available

story description: As a student who prefers to write in Kazakh or Russian, I want to submit my request in my own language and have it classified and routed correctly, so that I don't struggle to describe my issue in English.
Pre-Requirements: AI classification model (Story 1) is implemented; a language-detection library is available

story description: As a student whose request has been resolved, I want to rate the support I received and leave optional comments, so that the school can measure and improve support quality.
Pre-Requirements: Request status tracking (Story 5) is implemented; a request can be marked Resolved by staff

story description: As a school administrator, I want a dashboard showing request volume, AI routing accuracy, and department response times, so that I can monitor support-system performance and staffing needs.
Pre-Requirements: Request, feedback (Story 8), and staff-correction (Story 3) data is being logged

story description: As an IT administrator, I want the AI classification model to be periodically retrained using new labeled data, so that routing accuracy keeps improving instead of degrading over time.
Pre-Requirements: Feedback (Story 8) and staff-correction (Story 3) data is available; ML training infrastructure is provisioned
